scene: The turned valve drains a wall, revealing three transit bays.
picture: A flat side view along a drained stone floor. Far left, a yellow delivery truck rests with its ramp lowered. Left, the girl sits in her purple wheelchair beside the turned red valve. Centre right, a candy-striped steam train puffs beside an open gateway. Far right, a brass airship gondola sways at a low mooring post.
shown: a yellow box truck parked with its open ramp down on the far left
a puffing candy-striped steam train waiting at a platform on the centre right
a small brass gondola airship moored to a tower on the far right
